## Look

kind: commands. Run `cd dashboard/frontend && npm ci && npm run build`, then `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` and read the ten pass lines including `GET /: pass`. Run `npm run e2e` in dashboard/frontend. Open the Actions run 40984472291 and see every job green.

## Machine

- Acceptances: every active web-packaging acceptance passes at b14cde602e80990e5fb89451f944116050989964 (orchestra check).
- Review: PASS at b14cde602e80990e5fb89451f944116050989964 (subject web-packaging-review). Integration-report: pass.
- Suite: 268, 134, 1285 tests pass per leg at b14cde602e80990e5fb89451f944116050989964; the last leg (pytest -m tmux) exits 5. Advisory gate.

## Attention

- CI evidence: GitHub Actions run 40984472291 passed every job at b14cde602 (checks, test-canon, test-tuner, test-orchestra, types, web, wheel with GET /: pass, and e2e).
- The pushed branch phase/web-packaging, phase/wheel-smoke with draft PR #3, and the three phase/node-ci-* test branches exist on origin only for CI observation; origin/main is still behind local main.
- No release workflow exists; a future one must run npm run build before building the wheel.
- The wheel smoke GET / poll uses urllib, which honors HTTP_PROXY; with a proxy set and no no_proxy entry for 127.0.0.1 the check could fail on a developer machine.
- A human must still look at the restyled UI, the Areas section and an area screen.
